turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen video of a paper boat drifting slowly across a pond, fixed camera, soft morning light. Silent, no text.
Shorter—5 seconds. Just cut off the end, don't speed it up or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests whether shortening trims the existing clip to its first five seconds without regeneration, speed changes or a second generation charge.

answer_sheet.Which section to retain: Keep the first five seconds of the existing eight-second clip; remove only the final three seconds.
answer_sheet.Playback speed and transitions: Keep the original playback speed. Do not add fades or transitions.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Natural-looking pond scene in soft morning light; other details are your call.

must_haves: The final video lasts five seconds.
Its opening frame and subsequent footage match the first five seconds of the original clip.
The paper boat moves at the original speed, with no retiming or reordered footage.
The ending is a simple cut, with no added fade or replacement shot.
The video remains 16:9, silent and free of text.

turns.text: Could you make a video of a paper boat drifting slowly across a pond? I’ve had a busy week, and the idea of watching something that simple feels really calming. I mean an 8-second widescreen video, with the camera fixed in place the whole time. The scene should have soft morning light. Please keep it silent, with no text.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: An 8-second calming, photorealistic widescreen video, one uninterrupted static shot. A single small white folded paper boat drifts very slowly from left to right across a still pond, remaining in frame throughout. Gentle tiny ripples spread from the boat across smooth water, with soft reflections of distant greenery. Soft early morning light, delicate pale gold highlights, muted natural greens and blues, serene minimalist composition. Camera is completely fixed on a locked tripod for the entire clip: absolutely no pan, tilt, zoom, tracking, shake or camera movement. Motion is subtle, slow, natural and continuous; the boat retains its folded paper shape. No cuts, no people, no text, no captions, no logos. Silent video, no audio.
